# Copilot Instructions

## Project Guidelines
- BePositive project rules: always 3-layer separation (Interfaces in Base.Services/Interfaces, Implementations in Base.Services/Implementations, Controllers in Base.API/Controllers, DTOs in Base.Shared/DTOs). JSON naming policy is lowercase; enums serialize as strings. All entities inherit BaseEntity with Id, CreatedById, DateOfCreattion (intentional typo), UpdatedById, DateOfUpdate. Use AsNoTracking() for read-only queries. Avoid Include() on navigation properties with enum fields; use Select() of scalar properties. Response middleware wraps responses; services throw exceptions and controllers map them to HTTP codes. Use StringEnumBinderProvider for [FromQuery] enums. Follow migration naming convention. Follow provided endpoints, models, and eligibility logic. Always follow patterns for hospital admin retrieval, user id retrieval, registration in ServiceCollectionExtensions, controller attributes, and soft delete pattern.
